title: E0082: Dynamic extension loading
plain_english: Using `dl()` to load PHP extensions at runtime is risky and unsupported in most modern PHP configurations.
why_matters: Dynamic extension loading can: - Load malicious or unverified extensions - Bypass security controls provided by the base PHP installation - Cause instability or crashes if extensions are incompatible - Fail on modern PHP versions, as `dl()` is disabled in many configurations and removed in PHP 7.0+
bad_example:
dl('my_extension.so'); // loads extension at runtime
dl('php_mysql.dll');
what_it_checks: `dl()` function calls anywhere in the code
